Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, sorry, Agent P. I, uh... (clears throat) We're testing all the lair entrances while Doof is away on vacation.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Ow! Sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'll be doing the heavy lifting monitoring the mainframe here and Carl will do the easy work of climbing through ten thousand feet of tunnel checking each opening.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyway, Agent P, you can take it easy and enjoy a Doof-free day.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Tick-tock, Carl.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on phone) Perry the Platypus, whatcha doin'?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm on vacation! Ya miss me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello? Hello? Here, a selfie will make him jealous. (snaps a pic) Time to make my life look more glamorous than it is. Mmm! (sips his drink) Oh, cabana boy! What's his name? Benny? Ben? Benjamin? Benjamin!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know what we're gonna do today! It's the perfect day to make the perfect summer drink.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Which is clearly a lemonady iced tea.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (laughs) Respectfully, I believe you are mistaken. It is a tea-y lemonade.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, I agree. It's a combo, but it's gotta have quench! (slams pitcher on table)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, so this is your big project for today?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Quench!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! We thought we'd do a taste test to find the perfect tea-to-lemonade ratio.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (yawns) Okay, this looks pretty low stakes. Insert yawn here. Proceed. (leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come get a glass later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, no, thanks!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Shall we take it to the vats?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (belches) Quench! Quench!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If we're gonna figure out the perfect beverage ratio, we gotta make enough for everyone.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Everyone in the neighborhood?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Everyone in Danville.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (gives Isabella scorecards) Isabella, you have an amazingly nuanced palate.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I am the only Fireside Girl to secure the High Society Patch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Which is exactly why you'll be rating the satisfaction levels.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Check.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet, on chemistry balance?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (at the whiteboard) I have already started.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, you're testing quenchability.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Quench!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (starts sweating) I'm about to become very humid.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: First, a 50/50 blend. And taste!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sips) Hmmm. Five out of ten. Lovely bouquet, but unsatisfied.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Un-quenched!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmmm, needs less lemon. Or more sweetener.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (sips and writes on the whiteboard) Let us try 37% more tea.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And I want 137% more quench!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is not how math works, Buford.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Bookcase entrance, check.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Bookcase entrance. (puts down magazine) Got it. Keep it going, Carl. That's, uh... 1% done. We got a lot more to do.

Name: Carl
Dialog: "We"?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I think I'm stuck.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We've all got our own problems.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) Still not quenched!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) Needs more ice!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahhh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmmm. The low stakes have definitely been raised. But, as always, it would be pointless to get Mom because, as always, the Mysterious Force would just take this all away.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (grunts) This tunnel is a force to be reckoned with.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (echoing) I'm a force to be reckoned with!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. Hello? Mysterious Force? Is that you?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm listening!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're... You're really stuck?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes. Yes! I am really stuck in my life! Omigosh, Mysterious Force, you really understand me!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well... wiggle around a little.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, yes, I'm doing it!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You'll find you'll have more room than ya think, Carl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, actually, it's Candace, but I guess you can call me "Carl". There's a zebra that calls me "Kevin". Mysterious Force, if this is really you, I need you to show me a sign!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Wiggling's not working.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hold on. Let's see if this does it for you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) A sign!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, whatever you're doing, sir, none of it is dislodging me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, you gotta get over here! I think the Mysterious Force is contacting me through the bathtub!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, that's a new one. (She marks a spot on her Candace Bingo card.) Oh, Bingo! And yet, this is not the strangest call I've gotten from you, even this week! Be right over.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Careful! Only 2% more sugar, Ferb!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hmmm, a fine vintage, but I'm still not satisfied. (Holds up a "four" score card.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmmm. Yes. Am I detecting a coarseness on my palate?

Name: Buford
Dialog: My tongue's still like sandpaper. Pass!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mysterious Force...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Have you seen what the boys are doing out th—Oh, wow!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (quietly) Stacy, come in here! Listen!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What am I listening for? Your sanity saying, "Candace, find me"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (puts her finger to Stacy's mouth) Mysterious Force? Hmmm, nothing. Wait, I also heard over here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mysterious Force, reveal thyself! Nope, it's not here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It was in here before, I swear! (looks in plant) Are you there?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, I'm getting really worried.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (from fireplace) Don't worry, I'm still here!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, does this Mysterious Force have a low, commanding voice?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I can't believe I'm saying this, but I hear it, too!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mysterious Force, what do you want?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I do love ham sandwiches. (takes a bite)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (exclaims) You hear it! Stacy, d'you know what this means?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: The Force eats luncheon meats?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No. If it can tell me when it will take the boys' stuff away, I can get Mom to show up right before so she can bust once and for all! O Great Mysterious Force, when will thou takest away what the boys hath built?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What's with the "Ye Olde English"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I dunno. It's probably ancient. I'm respecting my elders.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Um...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Gimme ten minutes, Carl!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's coming in ten!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's coming in ten! Wait, who's "Carl"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's me, I'm Carl. It's my "Force Name". Keep up, Stace!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wait, what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) MOM!!! You have to be home in nine minutes or less! It is very important!

Name: Linda
Dialog: A specific timeframe. Keepin' it fresh. Nice! We're on our way.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, the Flynn-Fletchers are on their return route home! Stop your tomfoolery and wrap it up!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm still stuck, sir. It's hot and I'm so thirsty!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Benjamin? Benjamin? Benjamin? Ugh! Fine, I guess I'm gonna hafta work on vacation. What have I got to work with here? Hmmm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait til Benjamin gets to behold my Bring-Me-a-Drink-inator! Man, there is no grievance so petty that an inator can't fix it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Still not right.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (weakly) Not quenching... fading... (He falls down and tumbles on the treadmill.) But, y'know, this is kinda fun, too.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Huh, maybe satisfaction should be rated by someone less picky. Respectfully?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Are you calling me picky? Respectfully?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, if the pink bow fits.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think the heat's gotten to you guys. With all due respect. But we're so close! We can't give up now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's just lemonade!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I said 37%!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He put in 41%!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He must have 5 more minutes!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't care what you do,

Name: Buford
Dialog: but it's gotta have quench!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ya hear me?!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Quench, quench, quench!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sighs) 10.0!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (sips) Mmmm, the perfect summer beverage.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (gulps his drink and rips off his tracksuit revealing his usual clothes) QUENCH!!!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: There's nothing a hint of mint can't improve.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) Two minutes! We just have time! Hee hee hee hee hee!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So, what's my Mysterious Force name? Am I a Frederick, or am I a Dave—

Name: Candace
Dialog: C'mon, Stacy!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl? I can't even see you!

Name: Carl
Dialog: There's an entrance flap by my head. Maybe you can get into it to dislodge me.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Which one is it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, look at you kids with your little stand.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have a glass, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, this is nothin'! Wait till you see in the back!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Who's this big boy? Hmmm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, devastatingly aloof cabana boy whose name I don't quite remember, (He activates the inator.) but I'm pretty sure it's in the Benjamin family!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Prepare yourself to bring me a drink!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, finally! (drinks) Quenched!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! That last entrance isn't closing!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Whoa! Incoming, sir!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: But... But...

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! NOOOOOO! Why, Mysterious Force, why?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (going inside) Honey, the heat's gotten to you. Come get something cool that the boys made.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Phew! All entrances examined, sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Adequate work, Carl! Now for the international entrances.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I was so close!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (from the water spout) Next time you're stuck, I don't wanna hear about it, Carl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Curse you, Mysterious Force!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Tell 'im, "Carl"!
